description: Python source code implementing a COCO evaluation class for distributed object detection metrics, including methods for preparing results, merging evaluations, and running evaluation metrics, with references to pycocotools and custom utilities.

classes.name: CocoEvaluator
classes.description: Class for evaluating object detection results on COCO dataset in distributed mode, supporting bbox, segmentation, and keypoint metrics.

methods.name: convert_to_xywh
methods.description: Converts bounding boxes from (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) format to (x, y, width, height) format.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges evaluation results and image IDs from multiple processes.

methods.name: create_common_coco_eval
methods.description: Creates a unified COCO evaluation object from merged image IDs and evaluation images.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Runs per-image evaluation on given images and stores results, supporting different IoU types.
